widgets_values:
Create one 21:9 technical clothing reference sheet with three equal-width panels: LEFT front view, CENTER true side profile facing image-left, RIGHT straight back view.

Image 1 supplies the front clothing structure. Image 2 supplies the back clothing structure. Image 3 supplies only the target color; all clothing shape and construction come from Images 1 and 2.

Show only the target product from the structural references, keeping all of its components together. Exclude surrounding styling items that are not part of the target product. Preserve its proportions, lengths and visible construction. Preserve the visible separation between components and the openings in their silhouettes. For the side view, use only the geometry needed to connect the evidenced front and back; leave unsupported details plain.

Use an invisible ghost-mannequin presentation: naturally worn three-dimensional clothing volume with hollow garment openings, on a uniform light warm-gray background. The clothing is displayed alone, without a visible body or mannequin.

Use the same scale and upright alignment in all three panels. Keep each complete clothing view centered within its own panel with clear space around every outer edge. The panels contain only the clothing and background, without text, borders or dividers.

View alignment: FRONT faces the camera; SIDE faces image-left in true profile with shoulders and hips aligned in projection; BACK faces directly away. For front and back, weight rests gently on the right leg, the left knee soft and feet grounded slightly apart. For side, weight rests on the far leg, the near knee soft and feet grounded close together. Arms rest beside the body with softly bent elbows and a small gap at the waist. Render only the clothing on this invisible supporting form.

widgets_values:
【通用版｜换装 + 换色 + 换姿势｜三阶段工作流】

功能：
1. 换装：P1 商品正面 + P2 商品背面提供服装结构，阶段1生成 FRONT / SIDE / BACK Ghost 服装参考；阶段3把对应 Ghost 服装转移到人物底图。
2. 换色：P3 只提供目标颜色。保持 P1/P2 不变、替换 P3，即可在尽量保留原版型/结构的前提下换色。
3. 换姿势 / 换模特 / 换场景：修改阶段2的 FRONT / SIDE / BACK 三个【可编辑】人物底图提示词，再由阶段3完成换装。

【普通用户建议只改这些】
A. P1｜商品正面图（必填）
B. P2｜商品背面图（必填）
C. P3｜目标颜色参考（必填，仅取颜色）
D. 阶段2 FRONT / SIDE / BACK 三个 JjkText 提示词：
   - 可改：人物外貌、发型、配饰、基础内搭、场景、光线、摄影风格、表情，以及对应视角内的姿势细节。
   - 三个提示词的“共同描述部分”建议保持一致，只在最后的 FRONT / SIDE / BACK 视角段落做对应差异。
   - 可以换姿势，但若优先服装结构准确，建议避免双臂大面积遮挡衣服、坐姿、蹲姿、极端扭转或强透视。
   - 建议保留 FRONT=正面、SIDE=左向侧面、BACK=背面 的视角关系；如果改得过激，换装稳定性会下降。

【普通用户不要改这些】
1. 阶段1 Ghost Prompt：负责把 P1/P2 结构 + P3 颜色整理成三视角服装参考。
2. 阶段3 FRONT / SIDE / BACK 换装 Prompt：这是核心服装转移约束。
3. Flux2 Klein 模型、6步 Scheduler、采样器、Person latent、VAE、分辨率、裁切尺寸、节点接线与三路对应关系。
4. 不要把 P3 当版型参考；P3 只用于颜色。

补充说明：
- 支持单上衣、单裤/裙、连衣裙及上下装套装；最终效果仍取决于输入商品图是否清楚、正背结构是否一致。
- 三路阶段2人物图是独立生成，不是严格同一身份锁定；如果需要更强的人物一致性，需要额外的人物锁定方案。
- 背景不会自动根据 P3 衣服颜色改变；若衣服与背景反差不足，请只修改阶段2场景/背景描述，不要改阶段1和阶段3核心链路。
- 当前工作流目标是“可直接运行的通用母版”。想做个性风格，优先改阶段2，不要先动核心参数。
nodes.title: 使用说明｜通用版：哪里能改 / 哪里不要改

widgets_values:
Photorealistic full-body luxury fashion lifestyle photograph, like a naturally observed pause in an elegant private gallery courtyard.
A beautiful adult woman in her late twenties, with almond-shaped dark brown eyes, luminous ivory-beige skin and a refined, subtly alluring presence. Realistic translucent skin, elegant facial structure and balanced body proportions.
Soft dark-honey brown hair in a sleek low ponytail, with a few delicate face-framing strands falling naturally across the forehead and temples. Polished gold-and-pearl drop earrings, a slim sculptural gold bracelet and refined minimalist leather sandals create an elevated luxury look.
She wears a plain neutral-gray close-fitting sleeveless top and fitted short bottoms, both matte and undecorated.
An elegant private gallery courtyard: pale travertine walls behind the figure, a clean sculptural archway, refined stone paving, a quiet reflecting water feature farther to one side and restrained architectural greenery. Open space gives the setting a serene, luxurious and high-end fashion atmosphere.
Soft natural daylight from camera-left, shaped by open shade and pale stone reflections, with gentle luminous highlights, realistic depth and smooth shadow transitions. Skin shows natural light transmission and a clear, airy glow. Fixed level camera, natural perspective, full head and shoes visible with clear margins. The figure occupies about 80 percent of the image height.

FRONT: torso faces the camera. Weight rests gently on the right leg, the left knee soft with both feet grounded and slightly apart. Shoulders settle naturally; arms rest beside the body with softly bent elbows, a small gap at the waist and relaxed wrists. Her head turns slightly toward image-right, eyes looking beyond the camera with a calm, elegant and subtly alluring expression.
